links.outcome: Change in ChatGPT-4 guideline-question accuracy and completeness between baseline and two-month follow-up
links.effect: Open-ended accuracy rose from 5.38±0.71 to 5.74±0.51 (max 6) and completeness from 2.57±0.52 to 2.85±0.36 (max 3), p<0.001. Multiple-choice accuracy rose from 98.2% to 100%. True/false stayed at 100%.
links.quote: Open-ended question responses exhibited significant positive enhancements, with accuracy scores increasing from an average of 5.38 ± 0.71 to 5.74 ± 0.51 (max: 6.0) and completeness scores from 2.57 ± 0.52 to 2.85 ± 0.36 (max: 3.0).

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks ChatGPT-4's adherence to clinical guidelines for diminished ovarian reserve over time using a structured question set, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
